GOVERNMENT OF RAJASTHAN
INCOME CERTIFICATE
Certificate Ref: INC/2024/7789
Financial Year: 2023-2024
Date of Issue: 20/05/2024

This is to certify that RAMESH KUMAR MEENA, son of SHRI RAMESHWAR MEENA, resident of Bassi, Jaipur. The total Annual Family Income of the applicant from all sources is Rs. 4,50,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) for the financial year 2023-2024.

Issuing Authority: TEHSILDAR, REVENUE DEPARTMENT
